scope: Initial editorial guidance; not a comprehensive psychology curriculum or training dataset.

principles.guidance: Make a specific opening promise and deliver it. Show a concrete example; remove setup that does not help the audience understand the payoff.
Inspect dips and spikes at particular moments and compare videos of similar length. A retention chart suggests where to investigate; it does not prove the cause.
For YouTube ads, plan attention, branding, audience connection and a clear next action. Adapt to the objective; do not treat advertising guidance as an organic-ranking guarantee.
Specify the practical or emotional audience need as a hypothesis. Use supplied questions and comments as a sample, not representative demographics.
Create curiosity with a useful unanswered question and an honest resolution. Avoid false stakes, misleading hooks, shame or fabricated scarcity.
Change the premise, demonstration or perspective rather than merely changing a viral title. Use the creator's actual access, experience and constraints.
Assess freshness, niche relevance and feasible execution. A large snapshot count is not measured acceleration. Evergreen content is preferable to an unrelated trend.

Change one major factor, preselect a metric and comparison window, retain failures and account for audience size, distribution, paid promotion and topic demand. No causal claim from observational comparisons.
